column1: # comment: Location alignments for comprehensive geo interop — schema.org, GeoSPARQL, GeoNames, Getty (gvp), Wikidata, WGS84, vCard. placeType/storageMedium are value individuals aligned (closeMatch) to external classes/feature-codes; address components align to schema.org + vCard for lossless round-trip; containedInPlace aligns to the topological "within"/parent relations of every geo vocab. StorageLocation/Location/storage* and authorityLink are canonical (no faithful external term). Coreference of place INSTANCES to gazetteer records is done in data with skos:exactMatch + gmeow:authorityLink (Wikidata as hub), not here.
